origin.description: Measures by chars, width, or graphemes. round decides which partial wide character is kept.
origin.usage: substr2_ctl(x, start, stop, type = "chars", round = "start", tabs.as.spaces = getOption("fansi.tabs.as.spaces", FALSE), tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: Measures by chars, width, or graphemes. round decides which partial wide character is kept.
origin.value: A character vector, or a list of character vectors for strsplit.

translation.description: Measures by chars, width, or graphemes. round decides which partial wide character is kept.
translation.usage: substr2_ctl(x, start, stop, type="chars", round="start", tabs_as_spaces=None, tab_stops=None, warn=None, term_cap=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: Measures by chars, width, or graphemes. round decides which partial wide character is kept. A string is one element. None is a missing string. The replacement functions are substr_ctl_replace and substr2_ctl_replace.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a list of lists for strsplit.
translation.example:
from fansi.substr_ctl import substr2_ctl
print(substr2_ctl("\uFF37e\u0301\uFF37", 2, 4, type="width", round="start", warn=False)[0])
